name: Objection Catcher
description: Weekly objection-handling digest, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (analyze the week's calls, cluster objections, score rebuttals, write the digest) -> email the digest. CONFIRM against your builder before import: the Kiki sample this was modeled on is a per-call agent that posts to Slack, so four things here are best-effort and flagged in objection-catcher.md -> Build notes: (1) the @activepieces/piece-schedule trigger + version, (2) the askAttention context scope for a cross-call weekly query, (3) the email piece + send_email action name/version, and (4) the optional CRM outcome lookup. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: analyze_objections
nextAction.displayName: Analyze the week's calls and write the objection digest

input.prompt: You are the Objection Catcher agent. (1) Look at every call from the last 7 days that has a transcript. If there are none, output exactly: 'Objection Catcher ran for this week. No recorded calls with transcripts were found.' and stop. (2) For each call extract every objection: the objection quote, its moment timestamp (mm:ss), the category, the rep's response quote, and a short response-pattern label. (3) Cluster objections into this fixed taxonomy (merge variants, e.g. price/budget/too expensive -> Pricing): Pricing, Timing/Priority, Competitor, Feature Gap, Security/Legal, Integration, Authority, ROI/Proof, Contract/Procurement, Other. (4) Score each objection/response pair 0-100 on clarity, empathy, proof, and a clear next step; where deal-outcome data is available weight by meeting booked / stage advanced / opp won/lost. If an objection has no captured rep response, list it as unhandled and flag it as a coaching opportunity. (5) Rank categories by frequency and impact (won/lost delta, conversion uplift) and, per top category, select the 1-3 highest-scoring rebuttal snippets with a one-line note on why each worked. (6) Compute weekly stats: total objections, percent of calls with objections, week-over-week change, best-performing patterns, low-scoring coaching opportunities; and 2-4 concrete coaching tips per top category. Output the exact digest format in objection-catcher.md -> Output as plain text. Keep a constructive tone. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype adjectives, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: email_digest
nextAction.displayName: Email the objection-handling digest to enablement
